# SpeechKit wire fixture

The progressive body and definition were generated by compiling SpeechKit's
actual `AzureSpeechModels`, `CustomVocabulary`, `MultipartFormDataBuilder` and
`PCM16WAVFile` sources from the app's pinned revision
`4a7d06482656e925d2c2e7c17d8b281c2a2d2c69`.

The generator called `AzureSpeechAPI.definition` with MAI-Transcribe-2,
`.init(transcribeStyle: .clean)`, one Swedish language hint and fifty synthetic
dictionary terms (one at the fifty-scalar boundary), encoded its result with
`JSONEncoder`, and framed it with `streamingFile` and `streamingHeader`. The
request uses a fixed uppercase UUID boundary and 100 zero-valued PCM16 samples.
No network request, credential, recording or user data was used.

The omitted `timestamps` field is intentional: this is the real encoding that
launch clients send. The adapter must normalize it to an explicit `none`.
This fixture proves protocol compatibility, not transcription accuracy or the
app's real provider integration gate.
